context_requirements: Ectopic/plasma-membrane ATP synthase expression or high mitochondrial ATP demand
Intact mitochondrial membrane potential and electron transport chain
Functional p53 for robust CDKN1A induction (MCF7, HEPG2, A549, HT29)
Cancer cell metabolic dependence on oxidative phosphorylation
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
No induction of DDIT4, TRIB3, CHAC1, or ATF5 at 6 h
No oxidative-stress or UPR gene signature at 24 h
Strong transcriptional response in HA1E comparable to cancer lines
No CDKN1A induction in TP53-wild-type lines

evidence.supports: DIM inhibits mitochondrial H+-ATPase, lowers ATP, raises ROS, activates p38/JNK and induces p21 in MCF-7
ATP synthase is upregulated and plasma-membrane localized in breast cancer; aurovertin B inhibits proliferation and induces G0/G1 arrest and apoptosis
Citreoviridin inhibits ectopic ATP synthase and alters protein folding, cell cycle, cytoskeleton and MAPK/ERK signaling
Citreoviridin inhibits PPAR-gamma, activates autophagy and induces apoptosis in cardiomyocytes
